legacy_reference.note: v12 image-level mutation settings retained only as historical reference; trait_genotype_v1 does not use them.

design_targets.pattern_goal: new coherent pattern variants should remain visibly distinct
design_targets.brightness_goal: keep v15-v18 brightness behavior except for mild dark-tail enrichment
design_targets.color_phase_goal: brightness should usually converge before visible hue/saturation
design_targets.saturation_goal: muted moth-like body colors; avoid neon/high-chroma convergence
design_targets.major_color_mutation_goal: ordinary large hue mutations are rarer and bounded; dedicated sudden mutation reopens the full trait space
design_targets.pattern_color_goal: patterns may carry heritable local pigment color independent of body ground color
design_targets.comparison_preview_goal: moths are shown on the actual game background for visual camouflage comparison
design_targets.black_mutation_goal: a conspicuously dark mutant should appear somewhat earlier/often while preserving brightness-first convergence
design_targets.mutation_independence_goal: major hue, saturation, and brightness mutations are sampled independently
design_targets.pattern_color_visibility_goal: make inherited pattern pigment visibly distinguishable without changing pattern birth or hue mutation rates
design_targets.major_hue_mutation_supply_goal: increase far hue exploration without changing brightness, saturation, pattern, or round timing
design_targets.parent_selection_goal: use the agreed random 12-parent pool from survivors; repeat survivors only when fewer than 12 survive
design_targets.pattern_diversity_goal: broaden coherent symmetric pattern vocabulary without increasing total pattern-birth probability
design_targets.pattern_saturation_goal: patterns start muted but may evolve to high saturation if player selection favors it; no low hard ceiling
design_targets.cartridge_role: Frozen baseline for the continuous-trait evolution model. Environment, model, and run are independent.
design_targets.experience_goal: Prioritize fast, visually legible, playful evolution while preserving the core natural-selection causal structure.
design_targets.playful_environment_goal: May be used with biologically playful environments such as fried rice; environment still never directs mutation.
design_targets.special_mutation_goal: about once every five generations, redraw one offspring across hue, saturation, value, texture and pattern traits; only this event receives the special reveal
design_targets.entertainment_event_goal: ordinary mutations and large mutations remain unannounced; only the dedicated sudden mutation triggers anticipation and post-play reveal
design_targets.model_status: Education now shares the same continuous-trait evolutionary core and tuning as the entertainment model.
design_targets.education_goal: Use the same natural-selection core as entertainment; education differs primarily in presentation and added game layers, not in the evolutionary mechanism.
